supersedes.field: formal_support_policy.out_of_range and formal_support_policy.unsupported of the manifest above
supersedes.change: An observed or literature envelope describes data coverage, not a physical limit. A value outside it is reported as source extrapolation and never fails the audit or removes a site. Only physical errors, undeclared assumptions and unknown constraints fail. The manifest itself is unchanged.

within_support.meaning: inside the observed or literature envelope of an evidence-backed constraint

source_extrapolation.meaning: physically feasible but outside the evidence envelope; counted and reported per site, never dropped or clipped

declared_assumption.meaning: a quantity without evidence support whose value is set by a named frozen repository file, used in an allowed analysis role

physical_error.meaning: violates a physical law, a declared equipment capacity or the declared validity domain of the pinned model, or is not a finite number; treated as a simulator or implementation failure

undeclared_assumption.meaning: an assumption-type quantity without a declaring file, or used in a role its evidence does not allow

unknown_constraint.meaning: the record names no constraint in the manifest

no_exclusion_rule: The audit never removes, clips or reweights records or sites. Every record appears in exactly one category of the report.

assumption_rules.requires_declaration: evidence_class in {assumed, unsupported}, or formal_eligible is false
assumption_rules.declared_in: repository-relative path of the frozen config or document that sets the value; older flat paths are resolved with slowlab.frozen_paths

sensitivity_only.unsupported.executor_delay: manifest: delay distributions may appear only as a declared sensitivity assumption
sensitivity_only.unsupported.executor_failure_rate: manifest: failure rates may appear only as declared sensitivity assumptions
sensitivity_only.unsupported.fogging_realised_flow: fogging is not an action of the contract; any use is a sensitivity analysis
sensitivity_only.agc2024.fogging_capacity: fogging is not an action of the contract; any use is a sensitivity analysis

basis.capacity: declared equipment capacity of the facility in the task contract
basis.model_domain: range in which the pinned GreenLight greenhouse model is applied; values outside indicate numerical failure rather than climate

agc2024.lighting_capacity.note: 0 is lamps off; the literature support 20-200 describes dimmable output when on
